contexts.text: By day in a pillar of cloud () = that when there was a state of enlightenment, it was tempered by what is obscure of truth. By day, or in the day = in a state of enlightenment... Hence day = a state of enlightenment or of clear perception. AE 504:10.
The arrow that flieth by day () = the falsity which is openly taught.

Its gates shall not be shut by day () = that those will be continually received into the New Jerusalem who are in truths from the good of love from the Lord... By day = continually, because there is always light there.
The falsities which are known to be falsities, are meant by the arrow that flieth by day.
Protection against injury by too much light... is signified by a cloud by day ().
